title: Perimeter
summary: Start: enter Perimeter. The log opens the job and the helm marks the home buoy. Do: enter the ambush sight, 520 meters of the home buoy. The ambush holds the stake until a keel crosses that line. A raider takes a keel that lingers. The pocket is still a garden. Finish: after the sight is sprung, come inside Last Stake's shell. The Charter writes standing. Wreck rights stay red. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
